question: industrial-roller-doors

$/ea (one complete motorised door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)

band.basis: Sum of the ten components above for ONE complete motorised insulated roller shutter, 4.0m W x 4.5m H, supplied, installed, connected, commissioned and handed over: $9,243 to $15,648 per door, shown rounded as $9,250-$15,650. Nominal quantity of 4 identical doors on one Auckland warehouse, one installation visit: TOTAL $36,972 to $62,592, i.e. $37,000-$62,600; mid-point $12,445/door and $49,782 for the four doors. Amortised items are scissor lift ($160-$240/ea of 4-6 days) and delivery/offload ($105-$185/ea of one visit), $265-$425 of each per-door figure. GST exclusive, ex-preliminaries, ex-margin, design and consent fees, structural opening, 3-phase supply/isolator/containment, vision panels, wicket doors, fire rating, high-wind upgrade, remote controls beyond the fixed station, loop detectors, card/PLC interface, painting/patching and maintenance contracts — all excluded as instructed. Confidence is LOW: the curtain product specified (double-skin foam-insulated aluminium slat, powdercoated) has no QV row and is priced as a published uplift on a proxy rate rather than a direct quote; both door-price sources are silent on whether they are supply-only or installed; and the control station plus safety edge is an allowance. If the supplier's price is supply-only, or the door must be certified for a high wind zone beyond standard wind-lock guides, expect the top of the band or above. The underlying cost is a single email to a supplier: two of the three big drivers would firm up inside a day.

band.unit: ea (one complete door, supplied, installed, commissioned; also give x4 total)
band.basis: Sum of seven distinct components (door unit, motorisation, safety/controls, installation labour and commissioning, final electrical connection, delivery/offload, scissor lift), each priced either from a QV CostBuilder row (unreviewed) or a fetched published source, with two labelled allowances (part of the controls line, and delivery). No aggregate QV row is added together with its own components. Per door $9,240-$16,500; centre of band ~$12,870/ea. x4 nominal doors: $36,960 low, $66,000 high (~$51,500 centre). GST-exclusive, Auckland, Q4 2026 rates; excludes preliminaries, margin, design, consent fees, the structural opening, the 3-phase supply/isolator/containment, vision panels, wicket doors, fire or high-wind upgrades and any maintenance contract. Cross-check: the AU guide (source-7, fetched) states 'Insulated PU-core commercial doors are $280–$380/m² supplied.', i.e. roughly 18m2 x that band, consistent with the low end of our door-unit component. Confidence is LOW: the specified insulated aluminium slat curtain is not published by QV or by any NZ supplier page we could fetch, QV's own proxy steel-slat rows disagree with each other by ~35%, and the door-unit component carries a 1.6:1 spread. A vendor quote from Ulti Group, Glideaway, AceDoors/Windsor, Garador or DoorsNZ would narrow it.

band.unit: $/ea (one complete motorised door, supplied, installed and commissioned into a prepared opening)
band.basis: Sum of the ten components above, Auckland, GST exclusive, excluding preliminaries, margin, design and consent. Low = 6,192 + 620 + 810 + 1,100 + 320 + 120 + 250 + 200 + 82 + 60 = $9,754/ea. High = 7,121 + 1,280 + 1,080 + 2,300 + 450 + 250 + 418 + 400 + 245 + 200 = $13,744/ea. Centre = $11,750/ea, rounded. Total for the 4-door nominal quantity: $39,000 low / $55,000 high, centre about $47,000 (amortised scissor lift and delivery are already inside the per-door rates, so the 4-door total is simply 4 x the rate). Cross-check: the fetched price guide puts a medium (3-5m) commercial roller door turnkey at $5,000-$7,200 ex-GST for a typical 9m2 door - about $550-$800/m2 - which at our 18m2 lands at $10,000-$14,400/ea, consistent with this band; a 4x4m high-speed PVC door with light curtain is $10k-$14k installed on the same page, an upper context for a taller motorised opening. Allowances total $380-$850/ea, about 6% of the high band, so they are not carrying the estimate; the main cost driver rests on a cited QV row plus stated adjusters from a fetched NZ price guide. A firm vendor quote for the 77mm insulated aluminium curtain would convert 'medium' to 'high'.
